title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?
summary:
Nvidia and its co-founder Jensen Huang have been at the centre of the artificial intelligence (AI) spending boom.
The billions of dollars being funnelled into AI and the construction of data centres has bolstered the American economy, with Nvidia being one of the biggest spenders.
Huang played a major role in the company, leading its shift towards AI, and maintained a firm grip on the company, with up to 200 people directly reporting to him.
Such a move could spell a wider slowdown in AI investment, which would have an economic impact.
Kunjan Sobhani, senior technology industry analyst at Bloomberg Intelligence, expects the impact of Huang leaving to be "limited" for now as Nvidia has strong commitments and a deep order book.

title: Defeating Volatility: Market wealth at 10-month peak on peppy sentiment
summary:
SynopsisIndia's global market capitalisation has seen a remarkable upswing since October, adding about $500 billion and reaching close to $5.42 trillion.
This rebound has enabled India to reclaim its fifth-place ranking in the world.
The return of foreign investors, after a substantial sell-off in AI stocks, is a testament to India's recovery against the backdrop of ongoing economic and market turbulence.

title: Sensex, Nifty hit 9-month highs as bank stocks lead market rally
summary:
SynopsisThe BSE Sensex advanced 427.40 points, or 0.52%, to close at 82,532.19, while the NSE Nifty gained 96.30 points, or 0.38%, to settle at 25,387.40.
Both benchmarks ended at their highest closing levels since February 2026, before the Iran-US conflict triggered a sharp selloff in global markets.
